verdict.rationale: Postmark documents its own inbound processing: configurable inbound servers, inbound domain forwarding, email parsing, and retrying failed inbound messages. That covers receiving mail and handing it off. Its only documented inbound 'rules' are blocking rules, not routing rules that match on recipient or pattern and send mail to different destinations. Missing for 10: documented rule-based matching on recipient or pattern, routing different addresses to different POST endpoints, store-versus-forward actions per rule, and any hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can route inbound mail with rules — match on recipient or pattern and forward, store, or POST to different endpoints

citations.quote: Inbound domain forwarding \- Parse an email \- Configure inbound blocking \- Sample inbound workflow
Retry a failed inbound message for processing
